# Vendor Custom Options

Marketplace sellers can create, customize, and manage product custom options directly from their vendor panel.

---

## Accessing Vendor Custom Options

1. Vendors log in to their Marketplace Seller Panel.
2. Go to **My Product List**.
3. Click **Add New Product** or click **Edit** on an existing product item.
4. Scroll down to the **Custom Options** section.

![Vendor Product Edit Screen](/images/image-9.png)

---

## Adding & Configuring Custom Options

1. Click the **Add Option** button to insert a new custom option container.

![Vendor Input Types Selection](/images/image-10.png)

2. Fill in the required option properties:

| Field Name | Description & Usage |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Option Title** | The customer-facing title for the option (e.g., *Custom Text Engraving*, *Gift Wrapping*, *Warranty*). |
| **Input Type** | Select the input control format (see breakdown below). |
| **Is Required** | Set to **Yes** to make option selection mandatory before adding to cart. Set to **No** for optional choices. |
| **Price & Price Type** | Enter the price adjustment value. Choose **Fixed** ($) for absolute dollar additions, or **Percent** (%) for percentage additions calculated against product base price. |
| **SKU** | Specify an option SKU suffix appended to the base product SKU in order records. |
| **Position** | Numeric order value or drag-and-drop position sorting handle. |

---

## Supported Input Types Breakdown

| Input Group | Input Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Text** | **Field** | Single-line text input field (e.g., custom name engraving). |
| **Text** | **Area** | Multi-line text box (e.g., gift message notes). |
| **File** | **File Upload** | Allows customers to upload files (e.g., custom print logo, design PDF). |
| **Select** | **Drop-Down** | Single selection drop-down list. |
| **Select** | **Radio Buttons** | Single selection radio button list. |
| **Select** | **Check-Box** | Multi-selection checkboxes (customers can pick multiple choices). |
| **Select** | **Multi-Select** | Multi-line list box selection. |
| **Date** | **Date** | Date picker input field. |
| **Date** | **Date & Time** | Date and time selector. |
| **Date** | **Time** | Time selection picker. |

---

## Saving Custom Options

After configuring all option titles, input types, prices, and positions:

1. Click **Save Product** in the vendor action menu.
2. The custom options are immediately published to the storefront product page.
